parameters.text:
=Clean this student enrollment row and return ONLY a JSON object.

Raw data: {{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

Rules:
- Student_ID: keep as is (must match STU followed by 4 digits)
- Name: Title Case (e.g., Manoj K)
- Email: if invalid or incomplete, set INVALID_EMAIL
- Phone: if less than or more than 10 digits, set MISSING
- Course: normalize to Python, Machine Learning, or Data Science (e.g., ml -> Machine Learning)
- Fee_Paid: yes/YES/Yes = true, no/NO/No = false
- City: Title Case, if empty set UNKNOWN
- Enrolled_Date: convert from DD-MM-YYYY to YYYY-MM-DD format
Email: Add a new key "is_email_valid": true if the email format is valid, false if invalid.

Phone: Add a new key "is_phone_valid": true if it is exactly 10 digits, false if invalid.
Return ONLY raw JSON. No explanation. No markdown.
